instruction: make yourself a bit more concise from now on
summary: Drops the word budget from ~120 to ~80 and rewrites the opening line's brevity cue from "short and direct, not essays" to "fewer words, more signal" — slightly sharper framing that reinforces the tighter limit. The `go longer only when…` clause preserves flexibility for deep dives without needing an explicit ask for every nuanced topic.
